customers_say: Customers find the door lock to be of best-in-class quality, with simple installation and reliable performance. They appreciate its security features, including triple deadlocks and multiple authentication methods, while also noting its modern appearance and multiple unlocking options. However, the usability receives negative feedback, with several customers describing their experience as totally pathetic and the app as a waste.

reviews.title: Very good buy -- value for money and user friendly
reviews.body: Excellent product with good customer support. The technician did the installation neatly and cleaned up the place afterward. He explained the product and it's features clearly. It saves a lot of hassle of searching for keys and is also extremely good from a safety point of view. One suggestion would be to add face recognition as a feature.
